title: A Multi-Month Study of Git Commit Signing
abstract: arXiv:2608.29283v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Git commit signing, introduced in 2012, is one mechanism for establishing commit provenance in software supply chains, yet developer-controlled adoption remains rare and developers' experiences using it are understudied. To examine this experience, we conducted a three-month study with senior undergraduate and graduate computer science students (n = 22), whom we treat as proxies for junior developers. Participants configured commit signing independently, used it across four coursework projects, extended it to a second device, examined an external repository containing anomalous commits, and answered security-reasoning prompts. We found that while almost all participants successfully signed every commit and rated routine signing positively, many faced friction during setup, multi-device configuration, and repository verification. translated_title: Git提交签名的多月度实证研究
translated_abstract: Git提交签名于2012年推出，是软件供应链中建立提交来源（provenance）的一种机制，然而开发者自主采用的情况仍然罕见，开发者使用该功能的体验也缺乏研究。为了考察这一体验，我们对高年级本科生和计算机科学研究生（n = 22）开展了为期三个月的研究，并将他们视为初级开发者的代表。参与者独立配置提交签名，在四个课程项目中使用该功能，将其扩展至第二台设备，检查包含异常提交的外部仓库，并回答安全推理相关的问题。我们发现，尽管几乎所有参与者都成功地为每次提交进行了签名，并对日常签名操作给予积极评价，但许多参与者在初始设置、多设备配置和仓库验证过程中遇到了阻力。尽管整个学期都在使用签名，他们在验证过程中仍难以发现异常提交，超过四分之一的……
tldr: 研究发现，开发者虽然能够坚持使用Git提交签名并对其日常使用评价积极，但在初始设置、多设备配置和验证异常提交时仍面临显著困难，表明该安全机制的可用性亟待改进。
en_tdlr: Despite consistently signing commits and rating routine signing positively, developers face significant friction in setup, multi-device configuration, and struggle to detect anomalous commits during verification, revealing key usability gaps in Git commit signing.
